title: Billboards and Cell Towers Collect Rent From Brands and Carriers, and $120,000 Across These 3 Stocks Pays $5,077 a Year
summary: A highway billboard and a ridge-top cell tower run on the same simple model: own the structure, collect the rent. Three REIT landlords turn that rent into dividends, but one has already slashed its payout, and the ad-driven names carry their own boom-and-bust risk.
